obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original woman in her mid-twenties wearing a deep-cobalt bikini. The casting is an original adult fashion model. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline with her back toward the camera, her body remaining a clear rear view as she turns her head slightly toward the horizon. Frame her full figure from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Her legs stay close and softly adducted so the actual upper inner-thigh contours create a small patch of visible beach between them, producing a visible thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her long dark wavy hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the serene coastal setting. Keep the result polished and realistic, with natural proportions, authentic skin texture, and balanced emphasis on the overall swimwear silhouette and sunlit atmosphere.
